    How picks are scored

    Each parkrun you haven't done earns points for every challenge it moves forward. Finishing a challenge is worth 100, a new country 45, and progress is worth more the closer you are to finishing. If it's the closest place to get a letter or word you need, it earns a bonus. Travel then takes points off depending on how far you'll go.

    Questions

    Where should I parkrun next? Paste your parkrun results into wheretoparkrun and it shows you where to parkrun next: the parkruns you haven't done yet, ranked by how many challenges each one ticks off, from Alphabeteer letters and Compass Club words to new country flags, balanced against how far you want to travel.

    Is wheretoparkrun free and private? Yes. wheretoparkrun is 100% free and 100% private. There are no ads, no accounts and no servers storing your data. Your parkrun results stay inside your own browser.

    What are the rarest Alphabeteer letters? No parkrun starts with X, so Alphabeteer needs the other 25 letters. The rarest starting letters right now are Q (13 parkruns, such as Quakers Walk and Queanbeyan), I (19 parkruns, such as ITC Community Sports and Ifield Mill Pond), Z (20 parkruns, such as Zalew Borki and Zalew Wrzesiński) and Y (22 parkruns, such as Y Promenâd and Yackandandah Rail Trail).

    Can I plan a parkrun tour with friends? Yes. Click '+ Add a friend' to add their parkrun results on your device, tick who is coming under 'Who's running?', and switch to the 5-week plan to find parkruns that tick off challenges for everyone in the car.

    Challenge rules follow the community Running Challenges list (Alphabeteer skips X, since no parkrun starts with it). Event list from parkrun's public events feed, .
